'''''Onderon Sky''''' was a battered and old [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilder Varth]] offered to give it members of an [[Alderaanian Resistance]] team for a mission they were going on to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], if they didn't have their own ship.
